title: Craft Tampa

services.name: Brunch Cruises
services.desc: Join us for Tampa’s most unique brunch aboard Craft as we take you on a culinary and cocktail river journey. Our Executive Chef has freshly prepared a delectable menu, in America’s first open kitchen using gas cooking equipment on a river cruiser. As you pass beneath the many low bridges in the heart of Tampa with inches to spare, you will experience the best sites our city has to offer, including the historic Tampa Hotel with its iconic minarets dating back to 1891. You may just think you’re on a scenic river cruise in Europe! When making a reservation, guests can choose from three seating options: the air-conditioned dining room, the covered back deck, or the shared outdoor bar. Outdoor

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Craft Tampa offers a stunning waterfront setting aboard a sleek, European-style river cruiser. Designed for a smooth ride beneath Tampa’s iconic low bridges, our luxury vessel accommodates up to 150 guests, making it the perfect event space for any occasion. From your dream wedding to your birthday party, a corporate gathering or any other private celebration, every event is elevated with gourmet cuisine, handcrafted cocktails, and breathtaking skyline views. Make waves with an event your guests will rave about - set sail with Craft Tampa. services.name: Crafted History Cruise
services.desc: Set sail aboard Craft’s history lunch cruise featuring narration by one of Florida’s most esteemed historians, Rodney Kite-Powell. From tales of Henry Plant’s railroad to the evolution of Hillsborough County, Rodney’s narration promises to be both enlightening & entertaining. Rodney will also highlight a section on Tampa’s rich military history. This is more than just a river cruise; it’s a journey through time, bringing the vibrant history of Tampa Bay to life.
